title: Never show a learner their level
statement: Never show a learner an ability label, tier, group, colour or level name; keep any grouping, levelling and pacing inside the system.
detail: The grade-3 rulebook's register with the child forbids exposing an ability label, tier, colour, group or level, beside the rule to talk to the child as a capable reader. A reading quality canon bars any persistent, child-visible ability tier, level or group label and keeps levelling in the engine, quoting a child who said 'I was orange, and I knew I couldn't read'.

evidence.quote: Never expose an ability label, tier, colour, group, or level.
Talk to the child as a capable reader.
